data.name: Reasoning Sprint
data.description: Sixteen short puzzles. Pick the best answer. Each section gets harder as you go.
data.framework: Original items covering numerical, verbal, logical and spatial reasoning.

data.name: Thinking Style
data.description: How much do you agree with each statement about how you approach problems?
data.framework: Analytical, creative and practical thinking styles (after Sternberg's triarchic view). All items are original.

data.name: Grit & Risk
data.description: How much do you agree with each statement?
data.framework: Perseverance and risk-tolerance constructs from public research literature. Items are original and do not reproduce any copyrighted scale.

data.name: Interest Explorer
data.description: How much would you enjoy each activity? There are no right or wrong answers.
data.framework: Holland RIASEC interest theory (public). All items are original to PRISM.

data.name: What Matters To You
data.description: How much do you agree with each statement about your future work?
data.framework: Work-values dimensions common to public career-guidance frameworks. All items are original.
